title: Duck jumps onto a quadruped
goal: Train the Microduck to launch from the floor, land with both feet on a quadruped's back, and remain upright while the quadruped holds a stable stance.

quadruped.role: stationary landing platform for the first reproducible version

training.algorithm: staged optimization followed by policy refinement
stages: two-foot contact inside the back target

disclosure: The quadruped begins in and holds a fixed standing pose for challenge 005. Only the Microduck jump and landing controller is optimized; later variants may add quadruped motion after this baseline passes reproducibly.
